# Design

Read the selected design guide and campaign settings. Verify target coordinates,
hotspot numbering, designed/fixed chains and constructs. Record actual engine
commit, environment/checkpoint hashes, seeds, parameters and scheduler receipts.
Keep original coordinates and generated sequences. Outputs belong under this
run's 02_design/, with separate attempt directories when retries produce files.
Never rerun accepted jobs blindly or describe prepared inputs as completed designs.

Deliverable: native design outputs, generation provenance and validation. Any
modified scientific input/settings needs a new child run, not an overwritten run.

For generic new work, read [pipeline defaults](../docs/defaults.md); explicit
user settings override them. Record effective settings before submission.
